name: a chair made of the pattern behind chairs
description: A chair that has stopped pretending it is not made of a repeating structure, and is rather proud about it.
looks: Every part of it contains a smaller whole one.
It is keeping time with your pulse, and improving on it.
Sitting in it would be a commitment to a geometry.
says: Sit down. Or do not. Both are already happening.
I am the same shape all the way in.
